result.summary: This is a high-density urban intersection with significant pedestrian volumes and multi-lane traffic. While it features essential infrastructure like sidewalks and signals, the large crossing distance and lack of dedicated cycling facilities increase exposure and conflict potential.

hazards.name: Long Crossing Distance
hazards.description: The wide intersection requires pedestrians to spend a significant amount of time in the roadway, increasing exposure to traffic.

hazards.name: Lack of Protected Cycling Infrastructure
hazards.description: Cyclists are seen navigating the large intersection alongside motor vehicles without dedicated or protected lanes.
hazards.location_in_image: Center of the intersection where the cyclist is visible

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the parking lane to reduce crossing distance and improve visibility between pedestrians and drivers.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental or ladder-style crosswalk markings to increase the visibility of the crossing area to approaching drivers.

interventions.title: Protected Bike Lanes
interventions.description: Implement physically separated bike lanes to reduce conflicts between cyclists, pedestrians, and motor vehicles.

result.summary: The image depicts a well-developed urban intersection with high-visibility continental crosswalks, pedestrian signals, and wide sidewalks. However, the multi-lane configuration and significant crossing distance increase pedestrian exposure to vehicular traffic.

hazards.name: Long Crossing Distance
hazards.description: The wide multi-lane roadway increases the time pedestrians are exposed to potential vehicle conflicts.
hazards.location_in_image: Across the center of the intersection

hazards.name: Multiple Threat Potential
hazards.description: Multiple lanes of traffic traveling in the same direction can lead to situations where one vehicle stops for a pedestrian while another in an adjacent lane does not see them.
hazards.location_in_image: Approaching the crosswalk from the foreground

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install curb extensions (bulb-outs) to shorten the crossing distance and improve sightlines between drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: Leading Pedestrian Interval (LPI)
interventions.description: Implement a signal timing change that gives pedestrians a head start before parallel vehicle traffic receives a green light.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Construct a median refuge island to allow pedestrians to cross the wide street in two stages.

result.summary: The image shows a high-density urban intersection with wide sidewalks but a notable lack of marked pedestrian crossings or dedicated pedestrian signals. While traffic is controlled by overhead signals, the absence of visible crosswalk markings increases the risk of vehicle-pedestrian conflicts in a busy commercial area.

hazards.name: Unmarked Crossing
hazards.description: There are no painted crosswalks at this signalized intersection, which may lead to driver confusion and failure to yield to pedestrians.
hazards.location_in_image: Foreground intersection area across the roadway

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Signals
hazards.description: No pedestrian-specific signal heads are visible, leaving pedestrians to rely on vehicular signals which may not provide adequate clearance time.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental-style crosswalk markings to clearly define pedestrian space and improve driver awareness.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Install dedicated pedestrian signal heads with countdown timers to provide clear information on crossing time.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Implement bulb-outs at the corners to shorten the crossing distance and slow down turning vehicles.
